Bootstrap5Renderer override uses array_merge() to prepend framework classes then delegates fully to parent — zero code duplication, correct delegation pattern.

WP-005 (RendererSortHeaderTest): 5 tests save/restore both $_GET and $_SERVER[REQUEST_URI]. Both base and Bootstrap5 code paths covered. Assertions are direct and unambiguous.
WP-006 (XSS docblock): getSortURL() correctly documents the raw-URL risk. No XSS vulnerability introduced — getSortURL() output is passed to HTMLTag::attr('href', ...) which handles escaping.
